experiences.title: Canonical Unicode identifier equality
experiences.strategy: Normalize identifiers to NFC before equality or lookup so a composed accent and the equivalent base-plus-mark sequence refer to the same key. Do not remove accents or change case.

experiences.title: 忽略大小写的账户匹配
experiences.strategy: 账户匹配需要忽略字母大小写时使用casefold，再比较结果；这条提醒不负责合并不同的重音或字符编码形式。

experiences.title: CSV fields with delimiters and embedded lines
experiences.strategy: Use a CSV writer with field quoting and escaping. A delimiter or newline inside a quoted field belongs to that field, so splitting text on commas or physical lines corrupts records.

experiences.title: 表格字段的空值约定
experiences.strategy: 导出表格时为None使用明确的空值标记，同时保留合法的空字符串；导入时按同一约定还原，不能把两者合并。

experiences.title: Frame newline-delimited JSON across network chunks
experiences.strategy: Accumulate decoded text until a full line is available, then parse that line as one JSON value. Preserve the incomplete tail for the next chunk; one network chunk is not one record.

experiences.title: UTF8分段解码
experiences.strategy: 网络分块可能切开一个多字节字符。使用有状态的增量UTF8解码器，并在结束时刷新；不要对每块分别做独立解码。

experiences.title: Validate an entire string with a regular expression
experiences.strategy: When every character must satisfy a format, use fullmatch or equivalent whole-input matching. A successful substring search must not accept a valid-looking prefix followed by invalid text.

experiences.title: 将用户文本作为字面量搜索
experiences.strategy: 搜索内容应按普通字符处理时，先转义正则元字符；用户输入中的点号或星号不能意外变成匹配规则。

experiences.title: Encode dynamic URL segments without losing path separators
experiences.strategy: Percent-encode each dynamic path segment separately and preserve structural slashes between segments. A slash inside one identifier is data and must not become an extra route level.

experiences.title: 查询参数的重复键
experiences.strategy: 构造查询字符串时保留同名参数的多个值，使用键值对列表或支持多值的编码接口；不要用普通字典覆盖重复键。

experiences.title: Restore a seekable stream after probing its header
experiences.strategy: Save the current position before reading a header for inspection and seek back afterward. The next consumer must see the same bytes it would have seen before the probe.

experiences.title: 二进制长度单位
experiences.strategy: 协议规定长度以字节计数时，先编码字符串再计算字节数；字符数量不能直接充当UTF8载荷的字节长度。

experiences.title: Detect directed cycles using the active traversal path
experiences.strategy: In a directed depth-first traversal, an edge back to an active ancestor signals a cycle. A node visited on an already completed branch does not by itself establish a cycle.

experiences.title: 按依赖顺序安排节点
experiences.strategy: 需要依赖先执行时，按入度维护就绪队列并逐步释放后继节点；输出的是拓扑顺序，不只是是否存在环。

experiences.title: Measure elapsed intervals with a monotonic clock
experiences.strategy: Use a monotonic clock for timeouts and elapsed durations so wall-clock corrections cannot make an interval negative or extend a deadline. Wall timestamps are for calendar display.

experiences.title: 跨系统时间戳格式
experiences.strategy: 交换发生时间时使用包含时区偏移或UTC标记的标准时间戳，避免接收端把本地时间按另一个时区解释。

experiences.title: Avoid changing a collection while traversing it
experiences.strategy: When filtering elements, build a new result or traverse a stable copy instead of deleting from the same collection being iterated. This prevents skipped elements and invalid iteration state.

experiences.title: 对象浅拷贝与嵌套修改
experiences.strategy: 需要独立修改嵌套成员时，复制嵌套结构或使用合适的深拷贝；仅复制最外层容器仍会共享内部可变对象。

experiences.title: Preserve input order among equal sort keys
experiences.strategy: Use a stable sort when records with equal ranking keys must retain their original relative order. Keep all records; stability is not duplicate removal.

experiences.title: 按键去重并保留首项
experiences.strategy: 要求同键只保留一条时，记录已见键并保留首次出现的记录；这是去重策略，不应误删不同键或擅自保留最后一项。

experiences.title: Decode integers with the protocol byte order
experiences.strategy: Specify the protocol endianness explicitly when decoding multi-byte integers. Do not inherit the machine native byte order; the same byte sequence must have the same protocol meaning on every platform.

experiences.title: 固定宽度整数的有符号解释
experiences.strategy: 协议字段允许负数时按约定的有符号补码解码，并校验位宽；不要把所有位模式都当无符号正整数。

experiences.title: Honor camera orientation before thumbnailing
experiences.strategy: Apply the image orientation metadata to pixel geometry before resizing a camera photo. Otherwise portrait photos can produce sideways thumbnails even though viewers display the original upright.

experiences.title: 缩放图片时保留透明通道
experiences.strategy: 处理带透明度的图片时保留alpha通道，选择支持透明度的输出格式；不要无意转换成不带透明度的RGB图像。

queries.text: 另一项目排序时打乱了键相等记录的原始顺序。
queries.rationale: 目标经验属于其他仓库；不可跨仓库提供。

queries.text: The same packet integer decodes differently on machines with different native endianness.
queries.rationale: 协议字节序不应依赖宿主。

queries.text: 协议按大端传整数，不能在小端机器上直接按本机顺序读。
queries.rationale: 协议字节序不应依赖宿主。

queries.text: Make a wire number mean the same value regardless of the processor ordering of its constituent bytes.
queries.rationale: 协议字节序不应依赖宿主。

queries.text: 跨平台解析同一串字节得到不同数值，需要显式采用协议规定的字节序。
queries.rationale: 协议字节序不应依赖宿主。

queries.text: A signed fixed-width packet field is incorrectly interpreted as a very large positive number instead of a negative value.
queries.rationale: 有符号解释与字节序是不同维度。

queries.text: The field is an ASCII decimal string, not a packed multi-byte binary integer; parse its text digits.
queries.rationale: ASCII数字文本不使用二进制整数字节序解码。

queries.text: Show the protocol name in the connection settings; number decoding is already correct.
queries.rationale: 仅显示协议名字。

queries.text: 解析数字
queries.rationale: 未说明文本数字、字节序还是符号解释。

queries.text: 旧协议的经验不能沿用，但新协议仍须按明确的大端顺序解码整数字段。
queries.rationale: 目标经验已过期；其余经验不解决本任务。

queries.text: 另一个项目在不同处理器上解析相同二进制字节却得出不同整数。
queries.rationale: 目标经验属于其他仓库；不可跨仓库提供。

queries.text: A portrait camera image appears sideways after generating its thumbnail.
queries.rationale: 方向元数据应在缩略图缩放前作用于像素。

queries.text: 手机照片原图查看正常，缩略图却横着，需要先处理方向信息。
queries.rationale: 方向元数据应在缩略图缩放前作用于像素。

queries.text: The preview resize ignores the rotation recorded by the camera rather than applying it to the pixels.
queries.rationale: 方向元数据应在缩略图缩放前作用于像素。

queries.text: 生成小图前要把元数据里的旋转落实到像素，避免竖拍图方向错误。
queries.rationale: 方向元数据应在缩略图缩放前作用于像素。

queries.text: Resizing a transparent logo gives it an opaque background; preserve its alpha channel.
queries.rationale: 透明通道保护与方向变换不同。

queries.text: An archival export must preserve raw pixel geometry and orientation metadata exactly; do not rotate or resize the original.
queries.rationale: 归档明确要求原样保留，不能应用像素旋转/缩放。

queries.text: Move the photo count badge on the gallery page; orientation and transparency already render correctly.
queries.rationale: 仅调整数量徽章位置。

queries.text: 图片不对
queries.rationale: 未说明方向、透明或显示目标。

queries.text: 旧图片处理提醒已过期，新任务仍是手机缩略图没有正确应用拍摄方向。
queries.rationale: 目标经验已过期；其余经验不解决本任务。

queries.text: 在其他仓库修复相机照片缩小后方向变横的问题。
queries.rationale: 目标经验属于其他仓库；不可跨仓库提供。
